ai_recommendation.explanation: The "Balanced Engineering Fit" design, measuring 340.0 x 240.0 x 190.0 mm, is recommended for its optimized packaging volume, delivering substantial 73.6% volume savings. This design incorporates the ISO 2248 [ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION — MEDIUM fragility: 15 mm (ISO 2248 Category C equivalent)] minimum clearance, ensuring product protection. The BC Double Wall board provides a McKee box strength of 296.6 kgf, achieving a safety factor of 7.31, which comfortably exceeds the ISO 2234 [ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION — ISO 2234 stacking; SF >= 4.5 for 30-day ambient storage] requirement. Palletization is efficient with 80 units fitting precisely onto a 1200x800 mm Euro pallet, adhering to ISO 3676/3394 [Euro Pallet 1200×800 mm boundary. Zero overhang.] constraints. Physical lab tests are required to validate these ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTIONs before production.
ai_recommendation.confidence_reason: Medium confidence: General envelope provided; component breakdown or CAD center of mass would further refine internal cushion geometry.
assumptions: ISO 2248 ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Clearance 15.0 mm ≥ 15.0 mm floor for MEDIUM fragility. Physical drop test required.
ISO 2234 ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Safety Factor 7.31 ≥ 4.5 for 30-day ambient stacking. Physical stacking test required.
ISO 3676/3394: Pallet boundary 1200×800 mm Euro Pallet. 10 cartons/layer.
ISO 18602: Volume utilisation target ≥ 60%. Right-sizing validated by deterministic parametric calculation.
Board ECT values assume standard commercial linerboard (175/127/175 gsm kraftliner equivalent).
Warehouse storage assumes 23°C / 50% RH ambient conditions without direct weather exposure.
These constraints are ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTIONs derived from the ISO registry. Physical lab tests (ISO 2234, ISO 2248) must validate them before production.
missing_data: Detailed component breakdown (motor head vs pole vs base) to evaluate flat-pack disassembly.
3D CAD model (STEP/STL) to locate precise center of mass and optimize cushion contact points.
test_plan: ISO 2234: Complete static stacking test at safety factor 4.5 for 30 consecutive days under 50% RH.
ISO 2248: Free-fall drop test from 800 mm height across 10 orientations (1 corner, 3 edges, 6 faces).
ISO 13355: Random vibration profile simulation for 180 minutes representing road and freight transit.
